instruction.text: What do you think people were saying when protesting? Drag the correct phrase to the protest banner.
Select the protest banner to find out about Rosa’s activism.

finish.text: Rosa was part of a major organisation called the NAACP. They fought for the rights of black people in America.
finish.sound: Rosa was part of a major organisation called the N A A C P. They fought for the rights of black people in America.

instruction.text: You are speaking with Rosa about her famous, brave act of protest against segregation on December 1st 1955. Fill in the gaps.

atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>Where were you when this happened?</prosody>

atoms.b: I was on the ((++bus train)) on the way back from work.
What was your act of ((++protest jumping))?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>What was your act of protest?</prosody>

atoms.b: Buses were segregated so that white people were given a seat before black people. The bus driver demanded that I gave up my ((handbag ++bus_seat)), and I refused.
Were there any ((++consequences coins)) for this?
atoms.sound: ssml: <prosody pitch = '-1st'>Were there any consequences for this?</prosody>

atoms.b: Yes, I was arrested and ((++fined given)) 10 dollars. But I did not pay the money, also out of protest.

atoms.a: Do you think Rosa gave up with her protest after this?

feedback.finish: Rosa knew that she wanted to continue fighting against racism in America after this event.
